name: The Keith household at 1906 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_keith_mrs_edson

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 1906 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 1906 Mrs. Edson Keith.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 1906, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 40, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The three live-in staff it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Mrs. Edson Keith
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Edson Keith here as head, born July 1839, in Illinois, widowed (ED 40, sheet 4B, line 95, leaf n801).

persons.name: Hilda Johnson

born.note: The census gives November 1865, age 34 on 1 June 1900.

occupation.note: Written as "Ladies maid" in the occupation column on 1 June 1900.

persons.note: Enumerated on 1 June 1900 in the house, as a servant (ladies maid); born November 1865, in Sweden, came to the United States in 1889, single. Servants changed places often, so this records who worked here in 1900; no source read says whether this person was still here on 1 July 1904.
